name: Progress
description: Linear progress indicator with determinate and indeterminate modes.

ariaRequirements: aria-valuenow reflects value; omitted in indeterminate mode
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled. 2026-07-03 (batch 4) — indeterminate mode added: sweeping bar, aria-valuenow dropped, reduced motion slows the sweep instead of freezing it.

forbiddenUse: use Progress as a skeleton or layout placeholder; Skeleton owns loading layouts.
leave the default "Progress" aria-label on user-facing bars; name the work being done.
prefersOver: Spinner when completion percentage is known or the wait is long enough to show movement
dense: linear progressbar; determinate value/max or indeterminate sweep; sm/md/lg track, semantic state fill; aria-valuenow dropped when indeterminate

usage.description: Progress is the linear bar for work with visible movement: pass value (against max, default 100) when completion is measurable, or indeterminate when the duration is unknown but you want a bar-shaped affordance (e.g. a full-width page or panel load). The state prop recolors the fill semantically — success for a finished upload, error for a failed one. Rule of thumb across the loading family: Spinner for sub-second unknown waits, Progress for known or long-running work, Skeleton for placeholder layouts.

bestPractices.description: Name the work in the label prop ("Upload progress", "Profile completeness") — it is the aria-label AT users hear.
Switch state to success or error at completion so the outcome is visible without reading numbers.
Use indeterminate for unknown durations that deserve a bar (panel or page loads); the sweep keeps motion under reduced-motion by slowing, not freezing.
Pair the bar with a visible Text value or label when precision matters; the bar alone communicates proportion, not numbers.
Do not use Progress as a placeholder for content that is loading — Skeleton mirrors the layout; Progress claims measurable work.
Do not animate value backwards or reset it mid-task; regressing progress reads as an error even when it is not.
